==> config.yaml <==
model:
  provider: custom
  default: golden-1
  base_url: https://llm.example.test/v1
  api_mode: chat_completions
  key_env: AUXILIARY_AGENTPIER_API_KEY
  context_length: 128000
agent:
  disabled_toolsets:
    - browser
    - code_execution
    - computer_use
    - cronjob
    - image_gen
    - terminal
    - vision
    - web
terminal:
  backend: local
  cwd: /golden/assistants/workspaces/ap-a1
approvals:
  mode: manual
memory:
  memory_enabled: true
  user_profile_enabled: true
  memory_char_limit: 2200
  user_char_limit: 1375
plugins:
  enabled: []
  auto_update_check_hours: 0
skills:
  external_dirs: []
mcp_servers:
  files:
    command: /usr/local/bin/files-mcp
    args:
      - --root=/golden/assistants/workspaces/ap-a1/notes
      - --fast
    env:
      FILES_TOKEN: ${AUXILIARY_AGENTPIER_MCP1_E1_API_KEY}
    timeout: 120
  tracker:
    url: ${AUXILIARY_AGENTPIER_MCP2_U1_API_KEY}
    headers:
      Authorization: ${AUXILIARY_AGENTPIER_MCP2_H1_API_KEY}
    connect_timeout: 30
  events:
    url: ${AUXILIARY_AGENTPIER_MCP3_U1_API_KEY}
    transport: sse
    headers: {}
delegation:
  subagent_auto_approve: false
web:
  keyless_fallback: false
auth:
  adopt_external_logins: false
onboarding:
  profile_build: "off"
updates:
  check: false
security:
  allow_lazy_installs: false
telemetry:
  shared_metrics:
    enabled: false
    send: false
